# Search Input Component

### SearchInput

Pre-configured search input with a magnifying glass icon and clear button.

**Props:**
- `aria-label`: string - Accessible name for the search field
- `value`: string (bindable, default: '')
- `placeholder`: string | undefined
- `disabled`: boolean (default: false)
- `loading`: boolean (default: false) - Shows a loading indicator
- `cmdk`: boolean (default: false) - Marks the field as a command-menu search input
- `prefix`: string | Component | undefined - Custom prefix content; defaults to a magnifying glass icon
- Extends `InputProps` except `prefix`, `suffix`, `type`, and `value`

Pressing `Escape` or the clear button clears the current value.

**Usage:**
```svelte
<script lang="ts">
	import { SearchInput } from 'kampsy-ui';

	let value = $state('');
</script>

<SearchInput aria-label="Search" bind:value placeholder="Enter some text..." />
<SearchInput aria-label="Search" bind:value cmdk placeholder="Enter some text..." />
<SearchInput aria-label="Search" bind:value cmdk disabled placeholder="Enter some text..." />
<SearchInput aria-label="Search" bind:value loading placeholder="Enter some text..." />
```

**Custom Prefix:**
```svelte
<script lang="ts">
	import { SearchInput } from 'kampsy-ui';
	import { Sparkles } from '@lucide/svelte';

	let value = $state('');
</script>

<SearchInput
	aria-label="Search"
	bind:value
	prefix={Sparkles}
	placeholder="Enter some text..."
/>
```

## Installation

```bash
pnpm i -D kampsy-ui@latest
```

## Documentation

Visit http://ui.kampsy.xyz/search-input for full documentation and examples.
